provenance.cost: Integer nanodollars at list price. A weekday peak endpoint allows up to twice the base price; no holiday or account invoice is assumed.
provenance.reward: Original Harbor result, verifier reward.json, and evallab.results.load_trial primary_reward; invalid native rewards are not observed.
provenance.unsettled: A held call has a reservation but no verified usage. No reservation does not establish zero cost; its upper bound is unknown.
provenance.usage: Direct Flash ledger counts; input equals cache_hit plus cache_miss. Harbor per-seat totals are checked separately from the behavior claim. Available original per-turn receipts are cross-checked.
